label: setup new worktree
command: if [ -d "$ZED_MAIN_GIT_WORKTREE/.rfcs" ] && [ ! -e "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.rfcs" ]; then cp -R "$ZED_MAIN_GIT_WORKTREE/.rfcs" "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.rfcs"; fi && if [ -f "$ZED_MAIN_GIT_WORKTREE/CLAUDE.local.md" ] && [ ! -e "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/CLAUDE.local.md" ]; then cp "$ZED_MAIN_GIT_WORKTREE/CLAUDE.local.md" "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/CLAUDE.local.md"; fi && pnpm i
